objective: Minimize independent complete prefix replay time subject to all 36 truth points x3 conditions expected Fisher diagonal SE <=0.12; include every one of 420 cells, even counts balancing the two target heads.
selection: Round each feasible lower-cost optimum upward to an even count, repair numerical variance violations only. Otherwise use the smallest even feasible uniform start. Preserve original fit and recovery thresholds; expected Fisher is only a planning heuristic and does not establish global identification.
post_selection: Run 100 independent datasets at all original 108 truth/condition points only after forward/sequential conformance checks. Keep fit v5, all missingness conditions and original recovery thresholds.
